methodology.independence: Case/source/first/repair PNG/final reply inspected independently of the online reviewer verdict. Non-blind to implementation: auditor authored candidate reviewer changes. Not an independent human gold label and not a blinded model comparison.
methodology.freeze: Hidden bank and results were inspected only after root declared runtime freeze. No runtime changes or case-informed tuning in this audit.
